title: 477. Frog Jump

examples.explanation: Hop sizes 1,2,2,3,4,5 walk the frog from the first stone to the last.
The wide water gap after stone 4 cannot be crossed with any allowed step.
A single hop of length 1 reaches the final stone.

hints: Track, for each stone, the set of jump lengths that can land on it; the first hop must be 1.
From a stone reached with step k, only k-1, k and k+1 (when positive) can continue forward.
Stop early when a gap exceeds the largest reachable step, and memoize visited (index, step) pairs.
